subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: What supported capacity and upgrade behavior should `openclaw config set --batch-file` guarantee for existing batch files that exceed 8 MiB?
rationale: The shared bounded-read helper addresses the allocation risk, but selecting a fixed rejection threshold changes an existing CLI input contract and cannot be resolved mechanically from the implementation precedent.

options.title: Approve the 8 MiB limit
options.body: Adopt 8 MiB as the supported batch-file maximum and add concise user-facing documentation for the failure and alternative workflow.

options.title: Set a different supported limit
options.body: Choose a maintainer-approved capacity based on expected configuration-batch use, then update the constant, error, tests, and documentation together.

options.title: Defer the cap
options.body: Keep the existing input contract until maintainers choose a compatible bounded-read policy for configuration batches.

recommendation.title: Set a different supported limit
recommendation.body: Choose a maintainer-approved capacity based on expected configuration-batch use, then update the constant, error, tests, and documentation together.

likelyOwner.reason: The current discussion already asks this person to select the contract, making them the clearest available decision route.
